scope: Existing pinned local qwen3:8b, synthetic Aurora S1 facts; four Supervisor/PM model phases, read-only Knowledge/Memory, independent durable analysis; no generated execution or automatic approval/business write.

closed_findings.trigger: POST /api/chat HTTP error without confirmed completion after dispatch
closed_findings.original_effect: PROVIDER_ERROR could enter finish_call and release durable profile occupancy while original delivery/completion remained unknown.
closed_findings.fix: Workflow routes every dispatched reply lacking completion_confirmed=True to fail_unknown; keeps reservation and durable profile slot. No automatic resend.
closed_findings.regression: test_http500_unconfirmed_completion_holds_global_slot_across_provider_instances proves fresh provider instance/new analysis cannot issue even preflight requests while unknown slot is retained.

owner_reported_fixes_rechecked: start replay validates each saved call source; recover returns safe scoped metadata without private material/output
locked analysis reads refresh SQLAlchemy identity map before claim/fencing checks
caller and recipient-role source ACL intersection filters before source text and lexical ranking
source/caller/role/grant/witness bindings are reauthorized at dispatch, publication, reads and PM-to-Supervisor handoff
application output caps and v2 typed input projection preserve server-side exact sources and source statuses
real service tool receipts are bounded, source-bound and marked IN_PROCESS rather than MCP
separate analysis preserves S1 Gate, approvals, stage, receipts and Memory; model completion is analysis only

reviewer_did_not: invoke Docker or PostgreSQL live probes
limits: Root-owned actual pass/blocked/unknown/timeout model traces remain separate acceptance evidence; pending real cases are not counted by this review.
Tiny provider conformance and schema/citation validity do not establish factual model quality, throughput, hardware certification or production readiness.
No SRE, embedding/vector/RRF, paid API, external writes, SSO/RLS or arbitrary generated-code coverage is claimed.

S1 scripts/runtime_live_validate.py still writes its historical fixed evidence path; do not execute directly when preserving old archives. Use safe new output runner or an explicitly reviewed new-output change.
